# Star Light Cafe Hookah Bar

> Premium hookah lounge in Woodbridge, Virginia serving Al Fakher and Starbuzz shisha with handcrafted drinks, pool tables, live sports, and a relaxing atmosphere.

## Quick Facts

- Name: Star Light Cafe Hookah Bar
- Location: 14834 Buildamerica Dr, Woodbridge, VA 22191
- Phone: (703) 494-1004
- Hours: Tuesday-Saturday 5:00 PM - 1:00 AM, Sunday-Monday 6:00 PM - 12:00 AM
- Age Requirement: 21+ (federal tobacco law, valid ID required)
- Rating: 4.2 stars on Google (119 reviews)
- Website: https://starlight-cafe.com

## Hookah Menu

### Al Fakher (Classic)
White Grape, Double Apple, Orange, Strawberry, Peach, Watermelon, Pineapple, Vanilla, Mint, Mango, Lemon

### Starbuzz (Premium)
Blue Mist, White Mint, Gum, Sex on the Beach, Code69, Peach Mist, Irish Kiss, Melon Dew, Pan

### Pricing (both brands same price)
- Hookah (1-2 people, one device): $26 + tax
- Each additional person (same device): +$5
- Refill: $15 + tax
- Disposable Hose: $3.00

## Amenities

- BYOF (bring your own food welcome, outside drinks not allowed)
- Free Wi-Fi
- Pool tables
- Live sports on multiple screens
- Music on request
- Walk-ins welcome, no reservation needed
